entities.summary: The port of Luanda is an Angolan port located in the city of Luanda, the national capital, in the province of Luanda. It is connected to the city center of Luanda and the district of Ingombota. Right on the Luanda Bay, which is separated from the Atlantic Ocean by the island of Luanda.
